model_annotation: This horizontal bar chart illustrates the number of participants who selected various criteria when evaluating explanations, with categories listed along the vertical axis and participant counts along the horizontal axis. The categories, from top to bottom, are: “Relevant FCs” (6 participants), “FC Summary” (5), “Relevance Explanation” (3), “Clarity and Simplicity” (3), “Overall Summary” (2), “Filters” (1), and “Veracity Explanation” (1). The bars are color-coded in shades of purple, teal, and green, with darker shades corresponding to higher participant counts. The x-axis, labeled “Number of Participants,” ranges from 0 to 6 with tick marks at intervals of 2. The chart is tilted diagonally, giving it a dynamic perspective, and each bar is labeled with its exact participant count. The data shows that “Relevant FCs” was the most selected criterion, while “Filters” and “Veracity Explanation” were the least selected, each chosen by only one participant.
